description: This Java source file defines the main factory class for creating and manipulating JSON objects, arrays, values, patches, pointers, and related components within the Eclipse Ditto JSON API. It provides static methods for instantiating JSON structures, parsing JSON strings, creating field definitions, and managing JSON pointers and field selectors.

classes.name: JsonFactory
classes.description: Main factory class providing static methods to create and manipulate JSON data structures, parse JSON strings, define fields, manage pointers and selectors within the Eclipse Ditto JSON API.

methods.name: newKey
methods.description: Creates a new JsonKey instance from a character sequence.

methods.name: nullLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON null literal.

methods.name: getAppropriateValue
methods.description: Guesses and returns the appropriate JsonValue for a given Java object.

methods.name: newValue
methods.description: Creates a JsonValue representing a boolean, int, long, double, or String.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or reads from a Reader to produce a JsonValue.

methods.name: newObjectBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating mutable JsonObject instances.

methods.name: newObject
methods.description: Creates an immutable JsonObject from a string, map, or iterable of fields.

methods.name: nullObject
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing a JSON null as an object.

methods.name: newArrayBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating mutable JsonArray instances.

methods.name: newArray
methods.description: Creates an immutable JsonArray, optionally from a string or from iterable values.

methods.name: newField
methods.description: Creates a new JsonField from a key and value, optionally with a field definition.

methods.name: newPatch
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPatch for modifying JSON objects.

methods.name: emptyPointer
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer.

methods.name: newPointer
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer from a root key and optional sub-keys or from a string.

methods.name: newParseOptionsBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder to customize JSON parsing options.

methods.name: emptyFieldSelector
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: newFieldSelector
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector from a string, set of pointers, or field definitions.

methods.name: parseJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a JsonFieldSelector, returns null on empty or null input.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing complex JsonFieldSelectors.

methods.name: newStringFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON string values.

methods.name: newBooleanFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON boolean values.

methods.name: newIntFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON integer values.

methods.name: newLongFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON long values.

methods.name: newDoubleFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON double values.

methods.name: newJsonArrayFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON array values.

methods.name: newJsonObjectFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON object values.

methods.name: newJsonValueFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a field definition for JSON values of any type.

methods.name: createJsonArray
methods.description: Creates a JsonArray backed with an existing CBOR representation.

methods.name: createJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject backed with an existing CBOR representation.

methods.name: getNonEmptyPointer
methods.description: Converts a character sequence to a non-empty JsonPointer.
